scope: Offline evaluated mesh BVH rays from the saved Blender assembly. No Unity operation, no scene/model modification, no swept-capsule engine test.
snapshot_notes: Final complete snapshot after preview-only sea shader gradient and warm fill light update; layout, asset models and collision candidates unchanged. Read-only recheck, no scene save.
limitations: Missing asset instances are excluded, so their future occlusion and collisions remain unverified.
Trees have evaluated render geometry, which may differ from future simplified Unity colliders.
Camera rays are visibility diagnostics; a blocked ray does not alone establish an unusable composition.
Walk probes use eight radial spokes and vertical samples, not a continuous capsule sweep.
Foundation check is nine points per wall footprint; narrow local protrusions may be missed.
